implemented_behaviors: An active member can read and explicitly restore an archived organization through the lifecycle exception endpoint.
Creating a site, machine or invitation under an archived organization returns PARENT_NOT_AVAILABLE.
Creating or mutating a machine under an archived site returns PARENT_NOT_AVAILABLE.
An archived site or machine cannot be edited as active data; restore is an explicit is_archived=false mutation.
Hierarchy PATCH mutations retain expected_revision and stale updates return REVISION_CONFLICT without overwriting data.
The Organization/Site/Machine UI lists archived children and exposes explicit site/machine archive and restore actions.
